page.layout: One page of text in a single column; no margin notes; Hebrew, Syriac, Chaldee and Greek words set inline within the lines.

main_text.l: Item cohibere, occludere, Deuter.15.7. Pahel קִפַּץ
Idem. Ex Ithpahel מִתְקַפְּצָא Subsultans, scintillatim sc. Exod.9.24. in Jon.
קוּפִין Ch. Securis, Bipennis; vel malleus, ut Elias vult: Alii Gladium latum explicant. Convenit Grǫ. Κόπτς, Psalm.74.6.Exo.34.20.in Jon.
קִצַּח סָנָן Syr. Frangere. Ethpehal Participium
ܐܬܦܨܝ ܡܬܦܨܐ Quod pro vobis frangi-tur; 1.ad Corinth.11.24.
ܟܣܐ Syriac. Fractio, ܟܣܐ ܕܩܘܕܫܐ Fractio Eucharistiae, Act.2.42. Plural. ܟܣܐ Fractiones, Fragmenta, Mar.6.43.&8.8.
נִקְצָא Ch. Fragmentum, הִיד נִקְצָא דְטָסָא בִקְלָעָא Sicut fragmentum laminae in funda, Prov.26.8.
מִקְצָת קְצָר Chal. Pars; quidam, quaedam, in utroque genere & numero.
קִצָּח קִצְחָא Ch. Melanthion, Nigella, ut Hebr. Jesa. 28.25. Aben Esra scribit semen esse nigrum & cymino minus.
קִצָּם ܣܘܩܐ Syr. Divinare, Act.16.16. Idem quod קָסָם Ch. ם & ץ permutatis, ut פִּצְחָא, פִּסְחָא.
קִצְעָא קִצִּיעָתָא, קִצִּיעָא Chald. Casia. Plural. קִצִּיעָן Hebr. קְצִיעוֹת.
קִצָּף Ch. Effervescere irâ, Dan.2.12. Aliis est nomen, Ira fervens, Fervor, ut Esrae 7.23.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Greek forms are reproduced as far as legible; vowel points and diacritics in the Syriac and Hebrew lines are uncertain in places and may not match the print exactly. The final word at lower right (קִצִין) is a catchword or signature-like mark and is given as catchword.
